Subject: Acme renewal & expansion - recap and next steps

Hi Priya and Jared —

Thanks again for taking the time today to go through usage and the potential expansion for next year. Below is a quick recap + proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of what we covered
- Renewal window: current term ends 2026-10-01; target renewal decision by 2026-09-15 for an effective date of 2026-10-01.
- Current usage: base compute (text gen) ~1.2M tokens/day; embeddings usage spiked to 600k vectors during product launch last month (see attached usage CSV).
- Pain points:
  - Latency spikes on peak concurrency (esp. search/batch ingestion jobs).
  - Cost unpredictability from heavy embeddings usage and per-request batching patterns.
  - Need for stricter data controls for customer PII in the document search workload.
- New workloads discussed:
  - Semantic document search for support KB (~2B tokens/month projected once ramped).
  - In-chat retrieval + summarization for CS workflows (lower latency requirement).

Proposed expansion/upsell path
1) Dedicated capacity: add 2 x gpus (dedicated pool) to stabilize latency for search workloads.
2) Embeddings commitment: increase monthly embedding units and add automatic prefix caching for frequent queries.
3) Optional: Private VPC deployment pilot for PII-sensitive ingestion (timeline depends on procurement).

Pricing & timeline (ballpark)
- Dedicated capacity (2 GPUs) + embeddings uplift ~= $120k/year additional committed spend (final pricing to be confirmed).
- We can lock in the expanded commitment with a renewal by 2026-09-15 to enable the Oct 1 start.

Action items / owners
- Marissa (me): share detailed usage CSV + draft mutual action plan (attached: usage_report_Aug2026.csv, draft_mop.pdf) — today.
- Vivek: schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive to validate performance targets and sizing — by 2026-08-28.
- Priya/Jared: confirm procurement timeline and any procurement-specific docs we should route to (SSO, SCIM, data retention) — by 2026-08-27.

If that looks right, I’ll draft a MAP with milestones and dates so procurement has a single runnable doc.

Thanks —
